name: Exceptionless.Net
minimumRuntime: .NET 8 for ASP.NET Core, hosting, and Microsoft.Extensions.Logging. .NET Standard 2.0 or .NET Framework 4.6.2 for the core package.
summary: ASP.NET Core, worker services, console, WPF, WinForms, and Blazor apps, with Microsoft.Extensions.Logging, NLog, and log4net integrations

packages.name: Exceptionless
packages.description: Core client for console apps, services, and libraries.

packages.name: Exceptionless.AspNetCore
packages.description: ASP.NET Core integration: exception handler, 404 tracking, and request details.

packages.name: Exceptionless.Extensions.Hosting
packages.description: Generic host and worker service integration, with queue flushing on shutdown.

packages.name: Exceptionless.MessagePack
packages.description: MessagePack serialization for the stored queue.

snippets.label: ASP.NET Core
snippets.caption: Reads your API key from the Exceptionless section of appsettings.json when you call AddExceptionless() with no arguments.

snippets.label: .NET
snippets.caption: Works in console apps, services, desktop apps, and anything else on .NET. Unhandled exceptions are captured after Startup.

unhandledErrors.note: Startup hooks AppDomain and unobserved task exceptions. ASP.NET Core uses an IExceptionHandler.

logs.note: SubmitLog, plus Microsoft.Extensions.Logging, NLog, and log4net integrations.

notFound.note: Automatic in ASP.NET Core with UseExceptionless(). Call SubmitNotFound elsewhere.

userIdentity.note: SetUserIdentity. ASP.NET Core uses the authenticated user's name when none is set.

configValues.note: Settings, with a Changed event. Checked every 2 minutes while idle after Startup().

plugins.note: AddPlugin with a class or an action.

dataExclusions.note: AddDataExclusions, or a project-level exclusion list.

offlineQueue.note: The queue is in memory by default. Call UseFolderStorage or set StoragePath to persist it.

deduplication.note: Identical events within 60 seconds are merged into one with a count.

name: Exceptionless.JavaScript
minimumRuntime: ES2022 browsers, Node.js 18, and React Native 0.71 with React 18.
summary: Browser, Node.js, React, Vue, Angular, Express, and React Native with Expo

packages.name: @exceptionless/browser
packages.description: Browser client. Also available from a CDN as an ES module.

packages.name: @exceptionless/node
packages.description: Node.js client, including Express apps and serverless functions.

packages.name: @exceptionless/react
packages.description: React error boundary on top of the browser client.

packages.name: @exceptionless/vue
packages.description: Vue error handler on top of the browser client.

packages.name: @exceptionless/angularjs
packages.description: AngularJS module on top of the browser client.

packages.name: @exceptionless/react-native
packages.description: React Native and Expo client with native iOS crash reporting and a persistent queue.

packages.name: @exceptionless/core
packages.description: Shared core that the other packages build on. Install a platform package instead.

snippets.label: Browser
snippets.caption: Upload source maps to get readable stack traces from minified bundles.

snippets.label: Node.js
snippets.caption: Works in servers, scripts, Express apps, and serverless functions. Call processQueue() before a short-lived process exits.

snippets.label: React Native
snippets.caption: Works with Expo and bare React Native. Native iOS crash reporting needs a development or release build, not Expo Go.

unhandledErrors.note: Browser error and unhandledrejection events, Node.js uncaught exceptions and rejections, and React Native JavaScript errors plus native iOS crashes.

notFound.note: Call submitNotFound. The browser client reports 404s from jQuery ajax calls automatically.

referenceIds.note: Error events get a reference ID automatically. Read it with getLastReferenceId().

configValues.note: settings, with subscribeServerSettingsChange. Checked every 2 minutes while idle.

plugins.note: addPlugin with an object or a function.

dataExclusions.note: addDataExclusions, or a project-level exclusion list.

offlineQueue.note: Set usePersistedQueueStorage = true in the browser and Node.js. React Native persists the queue by default.

deduplication.note: Identical errors within 30 seconds are merged into one with a count.

sourceMaps.note: The server applies public or uploaded source maps to stack frames with absolute script URLs.
